entry_item.definition: (fr. T.,M.arban berkety); T. dkah bcu; S.krcchra, daça .[He who has mastered the] ten difficult things, i. e. who is able to interpret a term in ten different ways, title of a lama who has passed all the canid (mtshan nyid) examinations.
